Title: Implement custom de-serializers in Azure Stream Analytics (in preview)

Body.Content:
Stream Analytics now supports custom de-serializers. Parquet, Protobuf, XML or any binary format, developers can now implement custom de-serializers in C# which can then be used to de-serialize events received by Azure Stream Analytics.
 
Learn more
